# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs`. Do not edit this file by hand. -->

Lumina reads one TOML file. Every key is optional, unknown keys produce a
warning with a spelling suggestion, and invalid values are repaired
individually instead of discarding the whole file. Run
`lumina --check-config` after editing.

This reference is generated from the same annotated file that Lumina
installs on first run, so a key that exists in the product always appears
here and a default can never silently drift.

## Quick start

```toml
[general]
position = "top-center"
offset_y = 12

[appearance]
fill = "#12121ACC"
corner_radius = 18.0
height = 36.0

[rgb]
mode = "breathing"
primary = "#7C3AED"
secondary = "#06B6D4"
```

Colors accept `#RGB`, `#RGBA`, `#RRGGBB`, and `#RRGGBBAA`. Sizes are
logical pixels and scale with the monitor DPI factor. Changes apply live
unless the reference below says otherwise.

## Precedence

Values are merged from lowest to highest priority:

1. Compiled defaults
2. `config.toml`
3. Active theme file
4. Active profile, including inherited profiles
5. Command line flags
6. Session-only IPC changes

A theme or profile only contains the keys it changes. See
[themes](themes.md) for the authoring guide and examples.

## Reference

### Top level

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | `1` | - |

### `[general]`

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `position` | `"top-center"` | Which edge or corner of the screen the island sits on.<br>One of: top-center, top-left, top-right, bottom-center, bottom-left, bottom-right |
| `offset_x` | `0` | Horizontal offset from that anchor. Positive is to the right. |
| `offset_y` | `12` | Vertical offset from that anchor. Positive is downward. |
| `monitor` | `"primary"` | Which screen to use. One of: "primary", "cursor", or a 0 based index. |
| `auto_hide` | `false` | Fade the island out when nothing is happening. |
| `auto_hide_delay_ms` | `3000` | How long to wait before fading out, in milliseconds. |
| `always_clickable` | `false` | Keep the island clickable even while it is collapsed. |
| `idle_timeout_ms` | `5000` | Collapse after this long with nothing happening. 0 never collapses on its own. |
| `click_through_when_collapsed` | `true` | Let mouse clicks reach the window underneath while the island is collapsed. |
| `start_hidden` | `false` | Start with the island hidden, for example when autostarting at login. |
| `reserve_space` | `false` | Reserve screen space so maximised windows stop at the island instead of<br>sliding underneath it. Off by default because shrinking every window is a<br>surprise. Wayland honours this through the layer-shell exclusive zone. |
| `single_instance` | `true` | Refuse to run a second copy of Lumina. |

### `[appearance]`

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fill` | `"#12121ACC"` | Background colour. The alpha channel controls how see-through it is. |
| `fill_gradient` | `0.0` | Gradient strength from the fill colour toward the RGB secondary colour. 0 is flat. |
| `corner_radius` | `18.0` | Corner radius. 18 matches the shipped look. |
| `top_half_width` | `62.0` | Half width of the wider, top edge. The shape is 2x this across. |
| `bottom_half_width` | `54.0` | Half width of the narrower, bottom edge. |
| `height` | `36.0` | Full height, not half. |
| `inverted_trapezoid` | `true` | true gives the island its inverted trapezoid. false gives a regular trapezoid. |
| `border_width` | `1.0` | Border thickness. 0 removes the border entirely. |
| `border_color` | `"#FFFFFF24"` | Border colour. |
| `glow_spread` | `8.0` | How far the glow reaches, in pixels. |
| `glow_falloff` | `8.0` | How quickly the glow fades. Larger is tighter and more intense. |
| `shadow_opacity` | `0.28` | Drop shadow under the island. 0 removes it. |
| `backdrop_blur` | `"auto"` | Blur whatever is behind the island.<br>One of: auto (use the system's blur when there is one), on (always blur ourselves), off. |
| `backdrop_darken` | `0.15` | How much to darken the blurred background, which is what makes text readable. |
| `noise_strength` | `0.012` | Dither noise. Removes the banding you would otherwise see in gradients on an<br>8 bit display. Raise slightly if you still see banding. |

### `[rgb]`

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"breathing"` | Which colour engine to use.<br>One of: static, breathing, cycling, reactive, album<br>static    one fixed colour<br>breathing slow brightness pulse<br>cycling   hue rotates through the spectrum<br>reactive  colour follows whatever is playing<br>album     colour is taken from the current cover art |
| `primary` | `"#7C3AED"` | The base colour every engine builds on. |
| `secondary` | `"#06B6D4"` | The second colour, used by gradients and by the cycling engine. |
| `speed` | `1.0` | Global speed multiplier for whichever engine is running. |
| `brightness` | `1.0` | Lightness multiplier applied to the final colour. |
| `saturation` | `0.9` | Colour intensity multiplier. Lower values wash the colours out. |
| `breath_rate_hz` | `0.25` | Breathing engine: full cycles per second. |
| `breath_depth` | `0.18` | Breathing engine: how much of the lightness range to swing through. |
| `glow_intensity` | `0.6` | How bright the glow is. |
| `cycle_degrees_per_second` | `40.0` | Cycling engine: degrees of hue rotation per second. 360 is one second per full turn. |
| `transition_ms` | `300` | How long the colour takes to crossfade when switching modes or profiles. |

### `[rgb.reactive]`

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `gain` | `1.0` | Overall sensitivity of the reactive engine. |
| `floor` | `0.12` | Baseline amount of effect even in silence, so the island is never completely dead. |
| `bass_hz` | `250` | Upper edge of the bass band, in hertz. Bass drives the glow. |
| `mid_hz` | `2000` | Upper edge of the mid band, in hertz. Mid drives the border brightness. |
| `hue_spread_degrees` | `90.0` | How far treble energy rotates the hue, in degrees. |
| `glow_from_bass` | `0.55` | How strongly bass energy pushes the glow. |

### `[audio]`

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch for audio capture and the spectrum. |
| `source` | `"system"` | Where to listen.<br>One of: system (whatever you are playing), microphone (captures room audio), none |
| `device` | `"default"` | Device name substring, or "default" for the system default. |
| `backend` | `"auto"` | Capture backend. "auto" probes in the order PulseAudio, PipeWire, WASAPI.<br>One of: auto, pulse, pipewire, wasapi |
| `fft_size` | `"size-4096"` | FFT window size. Larger resolves low frequencies better and costs more CPU.<br>One of: size-1024, size-2048, size-4096, size-8192 |
| `band_count` | `32` | How many bars the spectrum is divided into. |
| `sensitivity` | `1.8` | Overall sensitivity. Raise it if the spectrum looks too quiet. |
| `attack` | `0.35` | How fast bars rise. Higher is snappier. |
| `release` | `0.08` | How fast bars fall. Higher is twitchier. Must not exceed attack. |
| `silence_threshold_db` | `-60.0` | Level below which the spectrum fades out completely, in dBFS. |
| `bass_tilt_db_per_octave` | `3.0` | Extra low frequency tilt, in dB per octave. Music has more energy down there,<br>so without a tilt the spectrum looks flat. |
| `normalize` | `true` | Track a rolling maximum so quiet tracks still show a full spectrum. |

### `[audio.visualizer]`

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `style` | `"bars"` | How to draw the spectrum.<br>One of: bars, mirror (symmetric about the centre), waveform, dots |
| `bar_spacing` | `2` | Gap between bars. |
| `bar_radius` | `3` | Bar corner radius. |
| `peak_hold_ms` | `400` | How long the peak marker above each bar lingers, in milliseconds. |
| `hue_spread_degrees` | `120.0` | Hue rotation across the band range, in degrees. 0 makes every bar the same colour. |
| `hot_tip` | `true` | Brighten bars that reach the top of the spectrum. |
| `baseline` | `true` | Draw a baseline so silent bands are still visible as small ticks. |

### `[media]`

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch for media player control. Works with Spotify, YouTube Music in a<br>browser, VLC, mpv, and anything else that publishes a system media session. |
| `hold_ms` | `6000` | How long the media panel stays open after playback stops, in milliseconds. |
| `show_album_art` | `true` | Show cover art. |
| `album_art_size` | `52` | Cover art edge length. |
| `album_art_corner_radius` | `8` | Cover art corner radius. |
| `show_progress` | `true` | Show the progress bar along the bottom of the island. |
| `progress_height` | `3` | Progress bar thickness. |
| `scrub_on_click` | `true` | Allow seeking by clicking the progress bar. |
| `show_volume` | `false` | Show a volume slider. |
| `marquee` | `true` | Scroll titles that are too long to fit. |
| `marquee_speed_px_per_s` | `40.0` | Marquee speed in pixels per second. |
| `marquee_gap_px` | `48` | Gap between the end of a title and its next repetition. |
| `marquee_pause_on_hover_ms` | `1800` | How long the marquee pauses while the pointer is over the island, so you can<br>actually read it. 0 disables pausing. |
| `preferred_players` | `[]` | Player names to prefer, most wanted first. Matching is case insensitive and<br>substring based. Leave empty for automatic ranking. |

|---|---|---|

| `contrast_target` | `4.5` | WCAG contrast ratio to preserve. 4.5 is AA for normal text, 7.0 is AAA. |
| `keyboard_focus` | `true` | Show a visible ring around the widget that has keyboard focus. |
| `focus_ring_width` | `2.0` | Focus ring thickness in logical pixels. 0 hides the ring. |
| `focus_ring_offset` | `2.0` | Gap between the focus ring and the widget bounds. |
| `focus_ring_color` | `"#FFFFFFFF"` | Focus ring colour. |
| `respect_os_reduced_motion` | `true` | Follow the operating system's reduce motion preference. The explicit<br>[motion] reduced setting still applies when this is off. |
| `screen_reader` | `"auto"` | Mirror status changes to a screen reader.<br>One of: auto (only when the OS reports one), on, off |
| `announce_min_interval_ms` | `1500` | Minimum time between spoken announcements, in milliseconds. |

### `[advanced]`

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `target_fps` | `60` | Frame rate ceiling when not waiting for the display refresh. |
| `vsync` | `true` | Wait for the display's vertical blank before presenting. Costs a frame of<br>latency, saves tearing and power. |
| `gpu_backend` | `"auto"` | Graphics API. "auto" picks the best available.<br>One of: auto, vulkan, dx12, metal, gl |
| `log_level` | `"info"` | One of: error, warn, info, debug, trace |
| `log_file` | `""` | Log file path. Empty uses the platform default. |
| `ipc_enabled` | `true` | Control socket, used by lumina-send and the language bindings. |
| `ipc_name` | `""` | Socket or pipe name. Empty uses the platform default. |
| `ipc_allow_exec` | `false` | Allows the \`execute\` IPC command, which runs arbitrary shell commands from any<br>local process. Leave this off unless you specifically need it. |
| `power_saving` | `true` | Request the low power graphics profile and cap the frame rate. |
| `experimental_wgsl` | `""` | Path to a WGSL file overriding the island effect. See docs/themes.md. |

## Structured entries

Three sections contain arrays of tables that are empty by default. The
examples below show every supported field.

### Shortcuts

```toml
[[shortcuts.list]]
id = "screenshot"
label = "Take a screenshot"
icon = "camera"
command = "flameshot"
args = ["gui"]
cwd = ""
hotkey = "ctrl+alt+s"
show_in_island = true
ipc_only = false
```

`id` and `label` are required and must be unique. `command` must be a
program name or path. It is executed directly, never through a shell.

### Script widgets

```toml
[script]
enabled = true

[[script.entries]]
id = "uptime"
label = "Uptime"
command = "uptime"
args = ["-p"]
cwd = ""
interval_ms = 60000
timeout_ms = 5000
display_ms = 8000
max_lines = 3
display = "text"
icon = "terminal"
show_in_island = true
```

Scripts run without a shell, have a hard timeout, and cap output at 120
characters per line. Read [the script widget guide](script-widget.md)
before enabling one.

### Per-widget overrides

```toml
[widgets.media]
enabled = true
flex = 2.0
margin_leading = 8.0

[widgets.media.rgb]
override_palette = true
primary = "#FF2D55"
glow_intensity = 1.0
```

Valid widget ids are `clock`, `media`, `spectrum`, `metrics`, `battery`,
`network`, `pomodoro`, `weather`, `notify`, `script`, and `shortcuts`.

## Safety notes

- `execute`, `notify.action`, shortcuts, and script widgets run local
programs. They are user-controlled configuration, not a sandbox.
- `[advanced].ipc_allow_exec` defaults to `false`; leave it off unless a
local integration genuinely needs to launch processes.
- `[advanced].experimental_wgsl` accepts arbitrary WGSL. It is validated
with `naga`, but it still runs on your GPU driver.
- Lumina has no telemetry. The optional weather widget is the only
component that makes network requests.
